text:
deploy-bot: Starting CONFIG-ONLY deploy for service=inference-svc (no binary changes). Planned changes: routing weights, request_timeouts, per-tenant limits, batching params. Canary -> 5% traffic for 30m. Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC tonight. /cc @alice

alice: tagging the rollout. This is config-only so should be low risk but watch the p95 latency. New routing policy will prefer v2-quant for non-sensitive routes.

carla: quick note — v2-quant has better perf on 80% of seq lengths, but tails can spike. Add KV cache bypass param for very short prompts?

alice: good call. we'll keep cache_on_prefix: true for now and add cache_bypass_threshold_tokens: 8.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview (dry-run) created: https://deploys.redwood/preview/1753200456
Included config snippet:
```yaml
service: inference-svc
routing: 
  default: v2-quant
  fallbacks: [v2-fp16, v1-sparse]
  canary: 
    percentage: 5
    duration_minutes: 30
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 45000
  generation_timeout_ms: 40000
limits:
  per_tenant_rps: 20
  max_tokens_per_request: 2048
batching:
  max_batch_size: 64
  max_batch_latency_ms: 12
  dynamic_batching: true
rate_limits:
  global_qps: 1200
  tenant_quota_minute: 1200
rollout: config-only
monitoring:
  health_check: /healthz
  latency_slo_p95_ms: 120
  error_rate_threshold_percent: 2
  auto_rollback_on_threshold: true
```

ben: oncall - I'm watching the canary window. If p95 > 200ms or errors > 2% for 5 continuous minutes we rollback. Please make sure the alert runbook is handy.

devin: i'll wire the synthetic probes and add a dashboard with delta comparison to baseline. Also enabling a short-lived trace sampling for canary traffic (10%).

emma: product note — we're changing routing for a couple of high-volume routes used by the assistant feature. Heads up to CS, marketing, and the demo team. frank, is there a scheduled demo tomorrow that conflicts with the 02:00 UTC window?

frank: there is a major EMEA demo at 03:30 UTC. Can we avoid full rollout during that time? Canary still ok as long as it stays at 5%.

alice: let's shift full rollout to start at 05:00 UTC if canary looks good. Keep canary at 5% during the demo window.

carla: one more: batching max_batch_size=64 might increase tail latency for small requests. Consider dynamic_batching with max_latency_ms 12 to bound tails. It's in the snippet but reiterating.

ben: agree. i'll set an on-call mute for non-critical noisy alerts during the demo but keep high-severity alerts.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled in 10 minutes. Notifying incident channel and CS. Rollback conditions: p95 > 200ms for 5m OR error_rate > 2% for 5m OR RPS drop > 30% for 3m.

alice: quick decision — proceed with canary now. If metrics look stable for 30m, we will increase to 25% for 20m, then 60% for 15m, then full. Manual gating between steps.

devin: runbook pointers:
- https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/inference-canary
- rollback playbook: remove canary weight and restore previous routing weights, revoke traces

ben: i'll be available for the canary window. if anything weird ping me directly.

frank: CS notified. I'll postpone customer-facing demo code push to avoid confounding variables.

alice: logging note — include config diff in release notes and in the audit log. Also tag the commit: cfg/1753200456

deploy-bot: Canary started. Monitoring endpoints: dashboards.redwood/inference/1753200456 and traces.redwood/1753200456

carla: if we see any token-level quality regressions, abort. We have evaluation probes streaming to the quality dashboard.

emma: will coordinate comms if we hit the rollback conditions.

alice: thanks team. keep messages short in this thread during the window. we will post a final status update here after the full rollout or rollback. :rocket:
